hypothesis: Complete multi-goal constraints and individually isolated edge, path, and paired-symmetry supervision can improve intrinsic fixed-metric Q geometry.
selection: Fixed-pose fit checks select by complete training distance Huber plus full ranking CE. Augmented conditions select by the same objective on validation poses. Test only once after selection; report last separately.
scope: Small diagnostic, not a full-state global map. New poses of the identical relative template test presentation transfer, not unseen relation types. Complete-pair and sparse-pair conditions match state encoding and optimizer updates, but not pair-label exposure or pair arithmetic; compare optimization, not data efficiency. All original protected states and all structural heldout-pose states are excluded from training.
followup: Do not automatically launch more expensive training. Interpret each isolated check before choosing a full-state condition.
